Q1: Column and propose-beyond-WIP only. `--as` goes as a task under c-088 (roles); `serve --bg` as a task under c-062.
Q2: Both. `run` pulls the top-RICE backlog card when a slot frees (createdAt order until c-061 ships); `card start <id>` jumps the queue.
